# opal_app_visibility (Data Source)

AppVisibility DataSource. Reads visibility via `GET /apps/{id}/visibility`, which only supports `CUSTOM` and `CUSTOM_CONNECTOR` apps. For other app types, read `visibility` / `visibility_group_ids` / `import_visibility` from the `opal_app` data source instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opal_app_visibility" "my_appvisibility" {
  id = "32acc112-21ff-4669-91c2-21e27683eaa1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `import_visibility` (String) The visibility level of the entity.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility level of the entity.
- `visibility_group_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of groups that can see this app when visibility is `LIMITED`.
Must be empty when visibility is `GLOBAL`.
